Riftur takes a requirement set (proposal instructions, audit criteria, evaluation rubrics, regulatory checklists, internal standards, etc.), interprets each item, and compares it to a document you upload. items.title: India proposes charging OpenAI, Google for AI training; lobbying group protests
items.raw_excerpt: India has proposed requiring companies like OpenAI and Google to pay for using copyrighted content to train AI models, sparking protests from industry lobbying groups who argue it would stifle innovation and increase costs.

title_i18n.en: India proposes charging OpenAI, Google for AI training; lobbying group protests
title_i18n.zh: 印度提议对OpenAI和谷歌的AI训练收费；游说团体表示抗议。
title_i18n.es: India propone cobrar a OpenAI y Google por el entrenamiento de IA; grupo de presión protesta.

excerpt_i18n.en: India has proposed requiring companies like OpenAI and Google to pay for using copyrighted content to train AI models, sparking protests from industry lobbying groups who argue it would stifle innovation and increase costs.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 印度政府提出新规，要求OpenAI和谷歌等公司为使用受版权保护内容训练AI模型付费。此举引发行业游说团体强烈抗议，认为这将阻碍人工智能创新并增加企业成本。该提案反映了全球对AI训练数据版权问题的日益关注。

items.title: Terrain Diffusion: A Diffusion-Based Successor to Perlin Noise

items.title: InspectMind (YC W24) – AI agent for reviewing construction drawings
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, we're Aakash and Shuangling of InspectMind ( https://www.inspectmind.ai/ ), an AI “plan checker” that finds issues in construction drawings, details, and specs. Construction drawings quietly go out with lots of errors: dimension conflicts, co-ordination gaps, material mismatches, missing details and more.
